calls.title: Growthbook & ActionNL Sync
calls.summary: The discussion centered on improving customer support through Microsoft Teams integration for better real-time communication and response time. GrowthBook emphasized using Slack or Teams for faster replies, with Chris Dizon designated as the primary contact for escalations. A technical issue regarding delayed data updates was traced back to Action's hosting environment, with plans for upgrades ahead. The team also established a clear channel for submitting feature requests and bug reports via integrated chats. Additionally, coordinating support across various global time zones was highlighted to ensure prompt assistance, addressing the logistical challenges faced by Action’s Netherlands-based team.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook Support, Microsoft Teams Integration, BigQuery Data Issue, Customer Success, APAC Technical Support, Self-hosted DOS Mode
calls.action_items:
**Cris Dizon**
Reach out to Mark and Action team to set up the Microsoft Teams channel integration with GrowthBook’s Slack system (17:55)

**Mark Weijkamp**

**Graham McNicoll**
